items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I went down to the grocery that Monday... I went out to James and the fellow was standing at the corner... This fellow come up. Boy, give me your hand, sir.

ctx.x: That's right. He was a man who's supposed to praise himself. He's got to lead that to the public. I told him, I said, well, maybe someday you might see me playing. I said, I played with St. Paul's Church. Because St. Paul's Church they told him I was first to make. They were behind an other band, wasn't my band. I came out for listening and went out to James and the fellow was standing at the corner. I told him, boy, I said, play me a good number. Play me a good hammer.
